settings.tagline: Hair, spa, nails and movement under one calm roof

services.name: Cut & Style
services.blurb: A wash, a cut that suits how you live, and a blow-dry.

services.name: Root Color
services.blurb: Roots matched to your colour, with a gloss to finish.

services.name: Signature Facial
services.blurb: Cleanse, exfoliate, mask and massage, matched to your skin.

services.name: Deep-Tissue Massage
services.blurb: Slow, firm work on the places that hold tension.

services.name: Aromatherapy Ritual
services.blurb: A full-body massage with warm oils you choose.

services.name: Classic Manicure
services.blurb: Shape, cuticles, a hand massage and polish.

services.name: Gel Manicure
services.blurb: Gel polish that lasts two to three weeks.

services.name: Deluxe Pedicure
services.blurb: A soak, scrub, massage and polish.

services.name: Reformer Pilates, private
services.blurb: One to one on the reformer, at your pace.
services.bring: Clothes you can move in. Grip socks: you can also borrow a pair at the desk.

services.name: Private Yoga
services.blurb: A one-to-one practice built around you.
services.bring: Clothes you can move in. We have mats.
